def choose_move(observation):
    obs = observation if isinstance(observation, dict) else {}

    gx = obs.get("grid_width", 0)
    gy = obs.get("grid_height", 0)

    me = obs.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    opp = obs.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])
    mx, my = me
    ox, oy = opp

    # Default: stay
    best_dx = 0
    best_dy = 0

    # Simple heuristic: move toward closest beneficial resource if safe, else approach neutral
    resources = obs.get("resources", [])
    obstacles = obs.get("obstacles", [])

    def in_bounds(x, y):
        return 0 <= x < gx and 0 <= y < gy

    def is_free(x, y):
        if not in_bounds(x, y):
            return False
        for oxs, oys in obstacles:
            if oxs == x and oys == y:
                return False
        return True

    # Try to head toward any resource if path seems reasonable
    best_score = -10
    for r in resources:
        if not isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) or len(r) < 2:
            continue
        rx, ry = r[0], r[1]
        dx = 0 if mx == rx else (1 if rx > mx else -1)
        dy = 0 if my == ry else (1 if ry > my else -1)
        nx, ny = mx + dx, my + dy
        if not in_bounds(nx, ny):
            continue
        if not is_free(nx, ny):
            continue
        dist_opp = abs(ox - nx) + abs(oy - ny)
        dist_res = abs(rx - nx) + abs(ry - ny)
        score = (0 if dist_opp == 0 else -dist_opp) + (10 - dist_res)
        if score > best_score:
            best_score = score
            best_dx, best_dy = dx, dy

    # If no good resource move, try to move away from opponent if adjacent
    if best_dx == 0 and best_dy == 0:
        dx = 0
        dy = 0
        if abs(ox - mx) <= 1 and abs(oy - my) <= 1:
            dx = -1 if ox <= mx else 1
            dy = -1 if oy <= my else 1
        ny, nx = my + dy, mx + dx
        if in_bounds(mx + dx, my + dy) and is_free(mx + dx, my + dy):
            best_dx, best_dy = dx, dy
        else:
            # try stay or random safe one-step

                    if in_bounds(nx, ny) and is_free(nx, ny):

                if best_dx != 0 or best_dy != 0:
                    break

    return [best_dx, best_dy]
